title.zh: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
title.en: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits

current_state.zh: HSBC and Ant Digital Technologies completed a testnet trial enabling AI agents to discover services and pay for them using HSBC's tokenized bank deposits with real-time settlement and risk checks.
current_state.en: HSBC and Ant Digital Technologies completed a testnet trial enabling AI agents to discover services and pay for them using HSBC's tokenized bank deposits with real-time settlement and risk checks.

updates.title_zh: 汇丰与蚂蚁数字测试使用代币化存款的AI代理支付
updates.title_en: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
updates.what_changed_zh:
汇丰（HSBC）与蚂蚁数字科技完成了一项测试网试验，使AI代理能够发现数字服务并使用汇丰的代币化银行存款为其付费，交易在区块链测试网上实时结算。两家公司周五发布的公告称，该试验结合了汇丰的代币化存款服务（Tokenised Deposit Service）、蚂蚁数字的Anvita Flow网络以及二层区块链测试环境Jovay测试网。

此次演示是银行主导的“AI代理代客户发起交易”试验中的又一例，此前桑坦德银行联合万事达卡Agent Pay、瑞士Sygnum在区块链主网以及CaixaBank联合Visa Intelligent Commerce均进行过受控测试。

两家公司将相关交易称为小额支付，通常指低于2美元的付款；汇丰提供结算能力与实时风险检查，蚂蚁数字的网络负责协调服务访问和支付。公司表示该测试仅限技术验证，不代表商业发布，也不是面向真实客户的服务。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: HSBC and Ant Digital Technologies completed a testnet trial enabling AI agents to discover services and pay for them using HSBC's tokenized bank deposits with real-time settlement and risk checks.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HSBC and Ant Digital Technologies completed a testnet trial enabling AI agents to discover services and pay for them using HSBC's tokenized bank deposits with real-time settlement and risk checks.
updates.background_zh: 代币化存款是将传统银行存款以区块链形式数字化表示，每个代币与商业银行持有的等额法币1:1对应。Anvita Flow被描述为一个链上代理协作网络，AI代理可在其中注册、发现服务并实时结算支付。投资研究机构Citrini Research在10月8日题为《Breaking The Wall》的报告中认为，自主AI代理可能推高对可编程、全天候金融基础设施的需求；而Augustus Bank首席执行官Ferdinand Dabitz在5月接受采访时则主张，传统清算银行依赖的是为人工操作设计的数十年前系统。
updates.background_en: Tokenized deposits are digital representations of conventional bank deposits issued on a blockchain, with each token corresponding 1:1 to fiat currency held at a commercial bank. Anvita Flow is described as an on-chain agentic collaboration network where AI agents can register, discover services and settle payments. In an Oct. 8 report titled "Breaking The Wall," Citrini Research argued that autonomous AI agents could increase demand for programmable, always-on financial infrastructure, while Augustus Bank CEO Ferdinand Dabitz argued in a May interview that traditional clearing banks rely on decades-old systems built for human operations.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若此类试点走向生产环境，银行发行的代币化存款将在公链上的代理式商业结算层与稳定币形成竞争，二层网络、代币化存款基础设施与稳定币发行方将成为该叙事下最直接相关的板块。但本次试验仅限测试网，未报告实际交易规模或客户资金参与。
updates.market_impact_en: If such pilots move toward production, bank-issued tokenized deposits would compete with stablecoins as a settlement layer for agentic commerce on public blockchains, making layer-2 networks, tokenized-deposit infrastructure and stablecoin issuers the segments most exposed to the narrative. The trial was confined to a testnet, with no reported live volumes or customer funds.
